description_expanded: ABOUT SEACREST 8 Seacrest Townhome #8 is a stunning two-story townhome perched directly on the Gulf of Mexico. Each level features a spacious porch overlooking the water, perfect for savoring your morning coffee while watching the sunrise or unwinding with a spectacular sunset in the evening. The first floor boasts a fully equipped kitchen and an inviting living room with a sleeper sofa. Whether you're preparing a meal or relaxing on the sofa, the panoramic view of the pristine white sand and turquoise waves will take your breath away. Upstairs, one bedroom offers a queen bed with views of scenic 30A, while the other features a king bed and a private porch with unparalleled ocean vistas. Seacrest Townhome #8 is perfectly situated along the iconic 30A corridor, nestled between the picturesque communities of Rosemary Beach and Seaside. Guests can easily explore the area's charming shops, local eateries, and vibrant attractions by bike or on foot. Spend your days basking on the sugar-white sands and your evenings experiencing the best of 30A's dining and nightlife. ABOUT THE AREA Seacrest Beach is a serene coastal retreat located on Florida's Emerald Coast. This charming community is tucked between Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach, offering a perfect balance of tranquility and proximity to vibrant attractions. Wander through cobblestone streets lined with cozy cottages and lush landscaping, and you'll find a vibrant village center filled with boutique shops, cafes, and restaurants. Seacrest Beach is known for its laid-back vibe, friendly atmosphere, and a variety of outdoor activities. Whether you're biking along scenic trails, exploring state parks, or enjoying live music at local events, there's something for everyone in this welcoming beachside community. BEACH ACCESS Direct access from the property 2 chairs and 1 umbrella included March - October PARKING Parking for 1 vehicle 2 Bikes Included PROPERTY RULES Must sign a rental agreement within 48 hours of booking to avoid cancellation Must be 25 years or older to book ABOUT PARADISE PROPERTIES Booking with Paradise Properties Vacation Rentals and Sales ensures a seamless and memorable vacation experience. All our properties are professionally cleaned, inspected, and maintained to the highest standards. With a local presence near our properties, we are available 24/7 to ensure your stay exceeds expectations. NOTE: Please be aware that this area experiences ongoing development and construction. Adjacent properties may undergo construction without prior notice. Paradise Properties is not liable for construction-related disturbances outside our managed properties.
